holdout_sample: All 2,304 BTC 5m Up/Down windows starting 2026-10-23 00:00 to 2026-10-31 00:00 UTC (8 days; 2026-10-30 is after as_of); 138,240 (window, side, 10-s bin) rows; 36,244 cluster maker BUY fills; 368,849 sampled taker prints for selection (all 33,697 cluster-filled + 10% of others). 12 windows on 10-29 18:00-19:00 UTC had no trades (market pause).

leakage_check.details: Constants only; presence and selection models and THETA_SEL reproduced exactly by BUILD-only refits; dev data and fetches end before H; truncation/corruption at each bin start on 40 windows x 30 bins: 0 feature/prediction mismatches (positive control t-1: 1,042/1,200 bins changed); price rule 656/656; selection 359/360 (prints in first 2 s use strike seconds published by the print time but after ts-2: not future data); inputs delayed 2 s: presence 0.6965 vs 0.6996; on-chain roles 150/150.

mechanical_fixes_made: None in final_rule.py. Driver exam/exam_run_evaluate.py sets final_rule.CACHE to .cache/re/directional-maker/exam and uses local=True (holdout day files fetched through the same adapters by exam/exam_fetch.py), because the adapter path holds ~2 GB of tuples for 8 days. 2-h slice: local and adapter paths give identical presence/price/PnL (tape rows 31,584 vs 31,587).
